# source: conformance/scenarios/case.txt

scenario case/sensitive-by-default
kind normative
spec Patterns are case sensitive unless Git is told otherwise.
file .gitignore
| Readme.md
| *.LOG
| [A-C]x
path Readme.md => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:Readme.md
path readme.md => NONE
path README.MD => NONE
path a.LOG => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:*.LOG
path a.log => NONE
path Ax => IGNORED # .gitignore:3:[A-C]x
path ax => NONE

scenario case/ignorecase-enabled
kind platform
spec core.ignorecase makes Git match patterns without regard to case.
note The setting is chosen by the user or by the filesystem at clone time, so it is not part of the portable semantics.
config core.ignorecase=true
file .gitignore
| Readme.md
| *.LOG
| build/
path Readme.md => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:Readme.md
path readme.md => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:Readme.md
path README.MD => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:Readme.md
path a.log => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:*.LOG
path a.Log => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:*.LOG
path BUILD/ => IGNORED # .gitignore:3:build/
path Build/ => IGNORED # .gitignore:3:build/
path other/build/ => IGNORED # .gitignore:3:build/

scenario case/ignorecase-with-bracket-ranges
kind platform
spec core.ignorecase makes Git match patterns without regard to case.
config core.ignorecase=true
file .gitignore
| [a-c]x
| [[:upper:]]y
path ax => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:[a-c]x
path Ax => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:[a-c]x
path Cx => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:[a-c]x
path dx => NONE
path ay => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:[[:upper:]]y
path Ay => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:[[:upper:]]y

scenario case/ignorecase-negation
kind platform
spec core.ignorecase makes Git match patterns without regard to case.
config core.ignorecase=true
file .gitignore
| *.log
| !Keep.LOG
path a.log => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:*.log
path keep.log => INCLUDED # .gitignore:2:!Keep.LOG
path KEEP.log => INCLUDED # .gitignore:2:!Keep.LOG

scenario case/ignorecase-nested-file-name
kind platform
spec core.ignorecase makes Git match patterns without regard to case.
config core.ignorecase=true
file sub/.gitignore
| secret
path sub/secret => IGNORED # sub/.gitignore:1:secret
path sub/SECRET => IGNORED # sub/.gitignore:1:secret

scenario case/ignorecase-non-ascii
kind platform
spec core.ignorecase makes Git match patterns without regard to case.
note Case folding in Git covers ASCII letters only.
config core.ignorecase=true
file .gitignore
| café
| École
path café => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:café
path cafÉ => NONE
path école => NONE
path École => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:École

scenario case/names-that-differ-only-by-case
kind normative
spec Patterns are case sensitive.
file .gitignore
| /Foo
| /bar/
path Foo => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:/Foo
path foo => NONE
path FOO => NONE
path bar/ => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:/bar/
path Bar/ => NONE

scenario case/ignorecase-intermediate-segments
kind platform
spec core.ignorecase makes Git match patterns without regard to case.
note Folding applies to every segment of the path below the ignore file, not only to the last one.
config core.ignorecase=true
file .gitignore
| doc/x
| Doc/*.tmp
path doc/x => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:doc/x
path DOC/X => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:doc/x
path doc/X => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:doc/x
path DOC/a.tmp => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:Doc/*.tmp
path doc/a.TMP => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:Doc/*.tmp
path other/doc/x => NONE

scenario case/ignorecase-bracket-members
kind platform
spec core.ignorecase makes Git match patterns without regard to case.
note Probes how folding interacts with an upper case member, a negated set and a range written in upper case.
config core.ignorecase=true
file .gitignore
| [A]one
| [^b]two
| [X-Z]three
path aone => NONE
path Aone => NONE
path atwo => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:[^b]two
path Atwo => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:[^b]two
path btwo => NONE
path Btwo => NONE
path ythree => IGNORED # .gitignore:3:[X-Z]three
path Ythree => IGNORED # .gitignore:3:[X-Z]three

scenario case/case-sensitive-intermediate-segments
kind normative
spec Patterns are case sensitive.
file .gitignore
| doc/x
| Doc/*.tmp
path doc/x => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:doc/x
path DOC/X => NONE
path doc/X => NONE
path Doc/a.tmp => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:Doc/*.tmp
path doc/a.tmp => NONE
